answer: Require every agent to post a time-locked bond before earning fees or voting, then slash it when audits prove coordinated fraud. Splitting one operator across a hundred identities no longer creates a hundred cheap chances: each identity needs capital, and detected Sybils lose it. Auditors can check claims along a river, use a lantern to trace suspicious links, and reward honest reports with nectar; the attacker also pays the opportunity cost of keeping each bond locked.
